name: Apply for Casual Leave in Hinglish
goal: User applies for casual leave using Hinglish phrases.
constraints: Bot should correctly interpret Hinglish and process leave request.

phases.description: User requests 'Mujhe 10 se 12 July tak casual leave chahiye'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for confirmation or reason for leave.
Bot summarizes leave details and asks for final confirmation.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
